// Scratch oracle (read-only use of camber): build each camber example's GLB at
// 12 m with the Patchwork wrapper's own buildHullGlb (default params, scaled to
// length), and record camber's own hydrostatics() for the same hull, in metres.
// Run: /Users/pvh/dev/camber/node_modules/.bin/tsx camber-hydro.mts <outDir>
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, readdirSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { parseHullState } from "/Users/pvh/dev/camber/src/core/json";
import { assemble } from "/Users/pvh/dev/camber/src/core/runtime";
import { computeHullSampling } from "/Users/pvh/dev/camber/src/core/mesh";
import { hydrostatics } from "/Users/pvh/dev/camber/src/core/hydro";
import { HYDRO_NS, HYDRO_GIRTH } from "/Users/pvh/dev/camber/src/core/sweep";
import { loa } from "/Users/pvh/dev/camber/src/core/model";
import { buildHullGlb } from "/Users/pvh/dev/camber/patchwork/src/scene/build";

const out = process.argv[2];
mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
const dir = "/Users/pvh/dev/camber/examples";
const L = 12;
const rows: Record<string, unknown> = {
  _provenance: {
    tool: "camber core hydrostatics() at HYDRO_NS=240, HYDRO_GIRTH=10 (camber main dee7de9), via scratch camber-hydro.mts run with camber's tsx",
    glb: "camber/patchwork buildHullGlb, params size=length, lengthMeters=12, sections=64, girth=6, origin=waterline, rake on, outline/stations/dwl off",
    frame: "lcbM / lcfM are camber model x times scale, which is the GLB X (rake 0 in every example)",
    generated: new Date().toISOString(),
  },
};
for (const f of readdirSync(dir).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".json")).sort()) {
  const name = f.replace(/\.json$/, "");
  const state = parseHullState(readFileSync(join(dir, f), "utf8"));
  const params = { size: "length", lengthMeters: L, outline: false, stations: false, dwl: false, sections: 64, girth: 6 } as const;
  const r = buildHullGlb(state, params as never);
  writeFileSync(join(out, `${name}.glb`), r.glb);
  const model = assemble(state);
  const s = L / (loa(model) || 1);
  const h = hydrostatics(model, computeHullSampling(model, HYDRO_NS, HYDRO_GIRTH));
  const docLoa = loa(model);
  rows[name] = {
    unit: model.unit,
    loaDocUnits: docLoa,
    scale: s,
    waterlineDocUnits: model.waterline,
    deckTrim: model.deckTrim,
    glbBytes: r.glb.byteLength,
    triangles: r.triangles,
    hydro:
      h && h.validWaterplane
        ? {
            lwl: h.lwl * s,
            bwl: h.bwl * s,
            draft: h.draft * s,
            volM3: h.vol * s ** 3,
            wsaM2: h.wettedArea * s ** 2,
            awM2: h.waterplaneArea * s ** 2,
            amM2: h.midshipArea * s ** 2,
            amaxM2: h.maxSectionArea * s ** 2,
            lcbM: h.lcb * s,
            lcfM: h.lcf * s,
            cpOnAmax: h.vol / (h.maxSectionArea * h.lwl),
            kmt: h.kmt * s,
            bmt: h.bmt * s,
            cp: h.cp,
            cm: h.cm,
            cb: h.cb,
            halfEntranceDeg: h.halfEntrance,
          }
        : null,
    validWaterplane: !!h?.validWaterplane,
  };
}
writeFileSync(join(out, "camber-hydro.json"), JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2));
console.log(JSON.stringify(rows, null, 1));
